column3: public C API of AngelScript 2.35.1 (ANGELSCRIPT_VERSION 23501, lines 61-62): asIScriptEngine/Module/Context/Object, the asERetCodes error enum, the asEBCInstr opcode list with asBC_JitEntry=175 (1398), engine property asEP_INCLUDE_JIT_INSTRUCTIONS=12 (128), and the two JIT types - asSVMRegisters (1197-1207, the VM register block shared with the JIT) and the two-method asIJITCompiler plugin interface (1211-1218)

the x86-64 JIT compiler, 4382 lines, read in full: bytecode-to-native emitter with a first pass that marks all jump targets so the optimiser cannot fuse across them (403-422, 846), a multi-op optimiser for SetV8/CpyVtoV8/ADDd and CMP+conditional-jump pairs (854-1118), deferred code pointers patched after compilation for mutual recursion (617-631, 3006-3013), the SystemCall bridge that maps 24 internal calling conventions onto native code (3210-3302), and code-page migration with jump patching when a page fills (762-776)

asCJITCompiler class plus enum JITSettings, seven independent speed/safety trade-off flags each documented with its cost (16-33: JIT_NO_SUSPEND, JIT_SYSCALL_FPU_NORESET, JIT_SYSCALL_NO_ERRORS, JIT_ALLOC_SIMPLE, JIT_NO_SWITCHES, JIT_NO_SCRIPT_CALLS, JIT_FAST_REFCOUNT); whole file guarded by #ifdef __x86_64__ (1, 60) so the class does not exist on other architectures
10-line MIT licence, Copyright (C) 2012-2016 Blind Mind Studios - the JIT sub-tree carries its own, more permissive licence, distinct from the engine's own src/angel/src/COPYING

POSIX half of the assembler back-end: SysV register assignment (6 int regs EDI/ESI/EDX/ECX/R8/R9, 8 XMM, lines 19-51), CodePage via mmap with PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC (76-85), finalize() mprotects down to PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC (93-96), refcounted grab/drop (87-89), and a pthread_mutex CriticalSection (100-115)

Win32 half of the assembler back-end: Microsoft x64 register assignment (4 int regs ECX/EDX/R8/R9, 4 XMM, lines 12-38), CodePage via VirtualAlloc PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE searching up to 256 addresses outward from the requested one (67-73), finalize() with FlushInstructionCache + VirtualProtect(PAGE_EXECUTE_READ) (82-87), CRITICAL_SECTION wrapper (95-106)

the actual x86-64 encoder, 1416 lines, read in full: mod_rm/sib byte builders (42-48), REX prefix computation (465-483), the fixed R11 scratch-register convention for 64-bit absolute addresses (381-384, 439-442, 522-527), short/long jump tables with out-of-page patching through R11 (534-603), MSVC x64 shadow-stack padding of 32 bytes (181-184, 312-314), and the x87 FloatingPointUnit emitters (1292-1413)

the assembler DSL header, 574 lines, read in full: Processor/Register/MemAddress/FloatingPointUnit/CodePage, the JumpType condition enum (71-91), CodePage as a bump allocator with a used watermark and a grab/drop refcount (129-177), and the documented 'R11 is supervolatile' scratch convention (31-34)

template asCArray, the engine's growable array: PushLast/SetLength/RemoveIndex/RemoveIndexUnordered/Concatenate/SwapWith, an inline buf[2*4*AS_PTR_SIZE] so one- or two-element arrays never allocate (94), and a deliberately PUBLIC array/length/maxLength so the JIT can read bytecode without a friend declaration (87-91)

asCAtomic implementation - atomic single-dword inc/dec for every refcount in the engine, with an asASSERT(value < 1000000) tripwire whose comment reads 'A very high ref count is highly unlikely. It most likely a problem with memory that has been overwritten or is being deleted' (46-68)
48-line declaration of asCAtomic - the thread-safe single-dword wrapper used for every reference count and bitfield in the engine

5307 lines; read the header, the symbol-table specialisation for global variables (51-57), the asIFilter comparator classes (60-75) and the constructor (79+) - the build orchestrator that parses scripts, registers every declared type and function, then compiles functions and globals in two phases because a script may declare a class after a function that uses it

262 lines: the pending-declaration structs that make a two-phase build possible - sFunctionDescription, sGlobalVariableDescription (isCompiled/isPureConstant/isEnumValue/constantValue), sClassDeclaration (validState + property initialisers), sFuncDef, sMixinClass (61-130) - plus the Build/CompileFunction API and the friend declarations for the engine, module, parser and compiler

2165 lines; read the header, Finalize() = PostProcess -> Optimize -> ResolveJumpAddresses -> ExtractLineNumbers (65-73), the JitEntry deletion when includeJitInstructions is off (1083-1088), the four asBC_JitEntry emission sites with the comment 'Add a JitEntry instruction after function calls so that JIT's can resume execution' (1618-1619, 1633-1634, 1649-1650, 1705-1706), and the packed line+column encoding (1702)

156 lines: asCByteCode declaration - the ~25 Instr* emitters covering every argument shape (113-134), the Finalize/Optimize/ResolveJumpAddresses/ExtractLineNumbers pipeline (69-76), and the AS_DEBUG-only DebugOutput hook (86-88)

112 lines: asCGarbageCollector declaration plus two explicit phase machines - egcDetectState naming every step (clearCounters/buildMap/countReferences/detectGarbage/verifyUnmarked/breakCircles, 78-94) and egcDestroyState - so the collector is a resumable state machine, not a recursive function

Each property allocates its own storage only when the type exceeds two dwords (84-91) so globals can be added and removed independently; a registered host property of object type is represented as a pointer to a pointer (93-98)

93 lines: asNEW/asDELETE/asNEWARRAY/asDELETEARRAY macros routing every engine allocation through the host's functions (74-78), with an AS_DEBUG variant that also receives __FILE__/__LINE__ (87-93); the file does not overload new because that would affect the application too (70)

1386 lines; read the header, the constructor/destructor (44-80), JITCompile() which walks the module's functions and JIT-compiles each (228-236) and the single-function path that invokes the JIT inline (1551-1555): the unit of compilation and ownership - the JIT pass is deliberately separate from the build pass so a module with no JIT costs nothing extra

55 lines: asSNameSpace (a name and nothing else - the header notes namespaces ought to have access masks, 43-44) and asSNameSpaceNamePair, the key type for every type map in the engine

51 lines: asCScriptCode declaration - SetCode, GetLinePositions, ConvertPosToRowCol, the sharedCode flag

The whole registration API (global functions/properties, object types/properties/methods/behaviours, string factory, arrays, enums, funcdefs, typedefs, config groups, modules), the JIT hook (83-84), the deferred build RequestBuild()/BuildCompleted() (240-241) with the isBuilding flag whose comment says it prevents multiple threads requesting builds at once without blocking (368-371), the one-entry lastModule cache (364-366) and six separate cleanup-callback registries (439-450)

312 lines; read the header and the two main helpers: asCompareStrings (46-70, length-aware, compares the shorter prefix first) and asStringScanDouble (72-85), which implements its own strtod because libc's is missing on some systems (iOS 5 is named) and is locale-dependent (may use a comma as the decimal separator)
34 lines: declares asCompareStrings, asStringScanDouble, asStringScanInt64, asStringFormat and the case helpers
